findings.reason: OPEN: A28 states Total (% of dose), so B28, D28 and E28 are percentages despite their mg column headers. A27 and A28 are summary labels within the time column. A single column-level unit cannot describe all body rows.
findings.needed_material: Confirm preparation preserves the printed headers and uses the A27/A28 row definitions for totals, separating interval amounts, total amounts and total percentages without conversion.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED, OPEN: D25 is explicitly not detected through b), while the unmarked dashes in B26:E26 have no supplied definition. No numerical detection limit or policy for incorporating nondetects into totals or group means is stated. E25 is a mean of two dogs without a printed SE; the reason for the reduced count is NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Source definitions for unmarked dashes, detection limits, summary handling of nondetects and the two-dog exception. Preserve all markers and distinguish missing, nondetect and zero pending clarification.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED, OPEN: A15 retains a) mg equivalent to meropenem and molecular-weight correction of H-4295, but no visible a) marker identifies its exact column scope. The administered salt/free-base basis and total/unbound basis are NOT_FOUND. IV is stated without bolus or infusion mode; health and renal state are unspecified.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the scope of note a), administered dose basis and relevant study-state and administration definitions before combining quantities or applying a physiological bridge. Retain the source corrections without recomputation.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED, OPEN: Reported interval amounts and collection timing are available, so urine volume is not required to reconstruct these reported amounts. Catheter collection is stated through 24 h, but completeness is not established; all analyte entries at 12-24 h are unmarked dashes. Individual versus pooled collection before summarization is NOT_FOUND. No complete-excretion claim follows from the printed totals.
findings.needed_material: If these amounts are used for renal-elimination interpretation, confirm collection completeness, dash meanings, collection experimental unit and the exact scope of the reported totals. Preserve the available collection window.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED, OPEN: A28/D28 provide a reported Meropenem total percentage of 72.1 ±5.8, separate from 14C recovery and H-4295. The single 120 mg/kg IV dose is stated. The precise total collection definition, completeness, dose basis and analytical definition needed to accept this as unchanged-drug fe remain unresolved. This is a reported, unrecalculated and independently unvalidated candidate.
findings.needed_material: If fe is used, confirm the reported Meropenem percentage definition, denominator basis, analyte specificity and collection scope. Do not substitute total 14C recovery for unchanged-meropenem fe.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED, OPEN: Urinary amounts and collection intervals are available, but this page contains no plasma exposure over corresponding intervals, no source-established plasma linkage and no reported CLR. The source evidence does not establish a compatible CLR input pair.
findings.needed_material: Only if CLR is selected, supply authorized, source-linked plasma exposure with matching study, regimen, analyte, interval, units and total/free basis, or a traceable reported CLR candidate with its definition and uncertainty.
